content: Clang defaults to -ffp-contract=on (contract within a statement) and arm64 always has FMA, so Apple silicon fuses a*b+c by default while x86 without -march=haswell does not; results differ in low bits (ImageMagick 8265, TISEAN 161). Box2D v3 disables contraction, ships its own atan2/sin/cos because CRT versions differ, and verifies determinism with a golden hash across worker counts. Gaffer/Dawson: transcendental functions differ across AMD/Intel and library versions; libraries can change FPU modes; uninitialized data and threading are non-float sources.
